top.jump: Jump to a case number or search…
auditor.readOnly: Read-only auditor access. Your access expires on {date}.
auditor.noExpiry: the date set by your administrator
status.label: Status label
status.tagHint: Every configurable value carries a status label: verified source, voluntary standard, company standard, or design default to confirm.
secret.once: Shown once. Copy it now and pass it on securely — it cannot be shown again.
reason.hint: Recorded in the audit log with your name and the time.
picker.userPlaceholder: Type a name or employee code…
picker.noUsers: No matching users at this site.
reg.noSaved: Filter the list, then save the filter for next time.
csv.pasteHint: First row is the header. Quotes and commas inside values are handled.
csv.preview: Preview — {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
csv.noHeader: No header row recognised — columns were taken in the documented order.
csv.import: Import {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
csv.nothingParsedHint: The text has no complete rows. Check the separators.
csv.unknownEmployer: Unknown employer — add the contractor first
csv.readFailed: The file could not be read.
login.tagline: Admin console for officers, managers and administrators
login.idHint: Staff sign in with the email on their account; others with their employee code.
login.staffOnly: Reporters and action owners use the SafeWorks app, not this console.
login.locked: Too many attempts. The account is locked for 15 minutes.
login.mfaBody: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app for {user}.
login.enrolBody: Your role requires an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Aegis…). Scan the code or enter the key, then type the 6-digit code the app shows.
login.mustChangeBody: You signed in with a temporary password. Set your own before continuing; other sessions will be signed out.
login.passwordRule: At least {min} characters with letters and numbers.
dash.title: Dashboard
dash.weeklyKicker: Good practice vs at-risk, with total
dash.repeatKicker: Same question failed at the same area or equipment on the previous run
dash.question: Question
dash.noDataHint: Widen the dates or pick another site.
dash.noRepeatHint: Nothing failed twice in a row at the same place.
attention.title: What needs attention
attention.overdue_actions.hint: Past their due date and not verified.
attention.triage_backlog.hint: SLA: triage within 1 working day; site head reminded at 2.
attention.critical_unacked.hint: Extreme or danger-now reports whose stop-work alert has no acknowledgement.
attention.missed_inspections.hint: Scheduled runs not started by due date plus grace.
attention.repeat_findings.hint: Questions failing again at the same place.
attention.rule_sets_unverified.hint: Enabled or assigned packs whose status is not verified.
attention.language_incomplete.hint: Keys missing in Hindi, Tamil or Kannada.
attention.health.hint: Failed sends, rejected syncs or a stale backup.
obs.emptyHint: Reports from the app and QR posters appear here. Print a poster to get the first one.
obs.reopenBody: The observation goes back to "Action assigned". Give the reason for the record.
obs.adminCannotTriage: Administrators configure the system but do not triage. A site safety officer, site head or HSE manager triages this report.
triage.title: Triage
triage.decision.accept_assign.hint: Rate the risk, pick the employer and create at least one action with a named owner.
triage.decision.accept_fixed_on_spot.hin: Rate it for the record; the report closes now.
triage.decision.return_to_reporter.hint: Send the reporter a question. Not possible for anonymous or QR reports.
triage.decision.reviewed_no_action.hint: Closes the report with a reason code and text.
triage.decision.merge_duplicate.hint: Link to an open master report at this site; the reporter is told when the master closes.
triage.decision.discard.hint: Spam or test entries. Reason code and text required; the discard rate is on the dashboard.
triage.decision.escalate_incident.hint: Records when the company learned of it and opens an incident with the same case number.
triage.dangerNow: The reporter flagged danger now. An interim control and the stop-work alert are required.
triage.is3786Hint: Pre-set from the report type: B-3 unsafe act, B-2 unsafe condition.
triage.controlHint: Hierarchy of controls: elimination first, PPE last.
triage.dueHint: Pre-filled from the band rule; change it only with a reason you would defend.
triage.interimHint: Required for High and Extreme: what keeps people safe until the fix.
triage.interimExtremeHint: Extreme: stop or do not start; senior approval to resume.
triage.stopWorkNotice: Submitting sends the stop-work alert to the site head and HSE manager; it must be acknowledged within 30 minutes.
triage.question: Question to the reporter
triage.questionHint: The reporter replies in the app; the report comes back to the inbox.
triage.returnBlocked: Cannot return an anonymous or QR report — there is nobody to ask.
triage.masterHint: Suggestions are reports at the same site and area within the duplicate window.
triage.masterSearch: Search by case number or words…
triage.learnedAtHint: When the company first learned of the event. Statutory clocks run from this time.
triage.escalateNote: Phase 1 records the time and shows the site's paper procedure; the incident module opens the case with the same number.
triage.err.interim: Interim control is required for this band.
triage.err.interimExtreme: Describe the interim control for this shift.
triage.err.reason: Reason code and text are required.
triage.err.question: Write the question.
act.emptyHint: Actions come from triage, inspections and incidents.
act.originalKept: The original due date is kept for the on-time KPI.
act.cancelBody: Cancelling needs the approval of a site head or HSE manager, recorded with the reason.
act.approverHint: A site head or HSE manager of this site.
act.cancelAudit: The reason and approver are written to the audit log.
ins.emptyHint: Runs are created from schedules or started on the spot in the app.
ins.reopenBody: The locked report is marked superseded and the inspector can edit answers again.
sites.sub: {count, plural, one {# site} other {# sites}} in your scope
sites.emptyHint: Create the first one — pick an industry and the categories, templates and QR posters are set up for you.
sites.codeRule: 2–8 capital letters or digits, e.g. TN1. Used in case numbers.
sites.name: Site name
sites.nameHint: Translations can be added after creation.
sites.govHint: Decides which OSH Code rules apply; most sites are under the state.
sites.ruleSetHint: Statutory timer pack. Drafts cannot be assigned until a reviewer enables them.
sites.effectiveHint: The switch-over is logged as a configuration change.
sites.matrixHint: Sites keep their version until changed here.
sites.wizardSub: Three steps: name the site, pick the industry, create. Posters are ready at the end.
sites.areasHint: Click an area to leave it out; add your own.
sites.noIndustriesHint: The server has no industry profiles loaded. Seed them, then try again.
sites.createNote: Creating the site sets its industry, creates the default areas, enables the industry's templates and categories, and prints-ready QR posters for the site and each area.
sites.postersHint: Each poster opens as a printable page in a new tab — one for the site and one per area.
sites.noPosters: No posters were returned by the server.
sites.siteHeadSet: A site head is set; type to change.
sites.hazardousHint: Factories Act s.2(cb) hazardous process — adds the MSIHC timers.
sites.geofenceHint: Reports outside this radius are flagged, never blocked.
sites.deactivateBody: The site is hidden from pickers; records and history are kept. Give the reason for the audit log.
areas.emptyHint: Add areas so reports and QR posters can point to the right place.
assets.pickSite: Pick a site in the top bar to see its equipment.
assets.swlHint: Safe working load for lifting equipment.
assets.nextExamHint: Statutory examination date; the app shows DO NOT USE when overdue.
assets.doNotUseNote: Scanning this equipment's QR will show DO NOT USE, offline too.
assets.emptyHint: Add lifting gear, extinguishers, scaffolds and other inspected items.
qr.label: Label
qr.labelHint: Printed under the code, e.g. "Scaffold zone, Block A".
qr.emptyHint: Create one per area so reports land in the right place; print the poster.
qr.pickSiteToCreate: Pick a site in the top bar to create codes.
qr.posterHint: "See a hazard? Scan to report in 30 seconds" in the chosen languages, QR as vector. Use the browser's print dialog.
qr.rotateHint: Issue a new token when a poster is abused; old posters stop working.
qr.rotateBody: Printed posters with the old code stop working. Reprint after rotating.
qr.prefillAnonymousHint: The QR form opens with the anonymous toggle on.
people.name: Name
people.emptyHint: People are workers without a login, used for names on reports and on-behalf entries.
contractors.name: Contractor
contractors.parentHint: Leave empty for a principal contractor.
contractors.sitesHint: Where this contractor works; reports and actions can name them there.
contractors.emptyHint: Add the employers working at your sites so reports and actions can name them.
users.name: Name
users.rolesHint: One row per role and site. HSE manager, admin and auditor cover all sites.
users.codeOrEmail: Employee code or email is required.
users.medicalHint: May see injury and medical details.
users.auditorExpiryHint: Auditor accounts expire after 30 days by default.
users.loginType.employee_code.hint: A temporary password is shown once; the user changes it at first sign-in.
users.loginType.email.hint: For staff. MFA enrolment happens at first sign-in.
users.loginType.enrolment_code.hint: A one-time code valid 24 h; the worker sets a password in the app.
users.staffEmailHint: Staff roles sign in by email with two-step verification.
users.mfaNote: Two-step verification is required for the roles in Settings; enrolment happens at first sign-in.
users.emptyHint: Add people one by one or import a CSV with their roles per site.
users.tempPasswordBody: Pass this to the user securely. They must change it at first sign-in.
users.enrolCodeBody: Valid until {until}. The worker enters it in the app and sets a password.
users.noSecretReturned: The account was created without a secret; issue an enrolment code or reset the password from the user's page.
users.mfaResetDone: MFA reset; the user enrols again at next sign-in.
users.deviceRevoked: Device revoked; it must sign in again.
cats.sub: Observation categories and the fields, recipients and defaults each one brings.
cats.name: Name
cats.recipientsHint: Roles notified when a report in this category arrives.
cats.criticalHint: Reports in this category may be rated Extreme and trigger the stop-work alert.
cats.incidentPromptHint: Shown at triage, e.g. "Fall from height" — nudges escalation.
cats.is3786Hint: Default cause code for reports in this category.
cats.emailDetailHint: How much the notification email reveals.
cats.extraFieldsHint: Extra questions on the report form for this category.
cats.emptyHint: Seed the default categories or add your own.
matrix.sub: Likelihood × severity bands. Versions are frozen on every rated record.
matrix.emptyHint: The server has no matrix versions; seed the default 5×5.
matrix.activateBody: The previous active version is retired. Sites keep their version until changed. The approver must not be the author.
matrix.assignBody: Pick the sites that should rate new reports with this version.
matrix.readOnlyHint: Create a draft version to change labels or bands.
matrix.editDraftKicker: Labels, anchors and bands in four languages
matrix.name: Name
matrix.err.cover: Bands must reach the top score {max}.
due.sub: How long each band gets, and who is reminded when.
due.rulesHint: Company default applies everywhere; add a per-site override where a site needs different limits.
due.appliesEverywhere: Applies to every site without an override
due.laddersHint: Negative offsets are before the due time, positive after. Steps before creation are skipped.
due.dailyCapHint: Reminder pushes per person per day; the rest go into the digest. Critical alerts are never capped.
rules.sub: Statutory timer packs per state and site type. Enable with a named reviewer; assign to sites with an effective date.
rules.disclaimer: Timers follow the brief's rule table; the status label says how far each was verified. Nothing here is legal advice.
rules.name: Name
rules.emptyHint: Seed the rule sets from the brief's §8.3 table.
rules.noDeadlineRefused: {n} timer(s) have no reviewed deadline; the server will refuse to enable this pack until they are set.
rules.draftRefused: Draft rule packs cannot be enabled or assigned until the rule is final and a reviewer is named.
rules.enableBody: Name the person who reviewed the deadlines and recipients against the source. Their name is stored on the pack.
rules.reviewerHint: Full name as it should appear in the audit log.
rules.assignNote: The switch-over is logged. Timers for events learned after the effective date use this pack.
templates.sub: Versioned checklists. Edit a draft, submit for review, another HSE manager approves.
templates.name: Name
templates.author: Author → approver
templates.emptyHint: Start from the library (T1 daily site walk, T2 scaffold…) or create your own.
templates.newBody: A first draft version is created; build it, then submit for review.
templates.copyBody: Creates a new template with a draft copy of the latest version — the quickest way to build a site-specific checklist.
templates.draftCreated: Draft v{v} created from the latest version.
templates.authorCannotApprove: Authors cannot approve their own version.
templates.inReviewNote: Waiting for approval by an HSE manager other than the author. Runs in progress keep their version.
templates.approveDone: Approved and active. The previous active version is retired.
templates.retireBody: No new runs can start on it; runs in progress finish on it.
builder.anyFailHint: One Fail makes the run Fail whatever the score (default on).
builder.competenceHint: Phase 2: sign-off is blocked without a valid recognition of this type.
builder.titleFieldsHint: Header fields asked once, comma separated (e.g. document number, scaffold bay).
builder.appliesHint: Leave all empty to offer the template everywhere.
builder.repeatableHint: Inspector adds copies, e.g. one per scaffold bay.
builder.guidanceImageHint: Shown under the guidance text on the phone.
builder.optFlagHint: A flagged answer counts as a failure.
builder.passRangeHint: Values outside the pass range are failures.
builder.actionOnFailHint: Submit is blocked while a failed answer has no draft action.
builder.dueOffsetHint: Leave empty to use the band rule.
builder.showIfHint: Only shown when another question has the given answer.
builder.referenceHint: Rule or standard behind the check, e.g. "BOCW r.54".
builder.previewEmpty: Add a section to see the preview.
builder.err.noFlag: {code} has action-on-fail but no flagged response.
builder.err.showIf: {code} refers to a question code that does not exist.
sched.roleHint: Any user with this role at the site sees the run as due.
sched.leadHint: How many days before due the run appears.
sched.graceHint: Not started by due + grace → Missed.
sched.areaHint: Leave empty for a site-wide run.
sched.emptyHint: Schedule a template per site, area or equipment; runs are created daily at 00:30.
lang.sub: Completeness per language, company overrides, import and export.
lang.allDoneHint: Every key has a translation. Search to override a specific one.
lang.overridesNote: Overrides apply to the app and the console without a release; blank clears an override.
audit.sub: Every change, login, export and sensitive view, hash-chained.
audit.chainBad: Chain broken at row {id} of {rows} (checked {at}). Treat the log after that row as unreliable and investigate.
audit.emptyHint: Every write lands here; widen the dates.
audit.maskedNote: Phones and contacts are masked inside changes.
notif.sub: Pushes and emails sent by the ladder, alerts and digests.
notif.emptyHint: Reminders and alerts appear here once the jobs run.
privacy.sub: DPDP: notices, requests and the 90-day grievance clock.
privacy.noticesHint: A new version is shown to every user at next sign-in; acknowledgements are stored per version.
privacy.newNoticeBody: Write the notice in English and the Eighth-Schedule languages your sites use. Publishing creates the next version.
privacy.noNoticeHint: Publish the first version so the app can show it before the first report.
privacy.ackNote: Each user's acknowledged version is stored on their account.
privacy.slaNote: Grievances must be answered within 90 days; escalation at 30 and 60 days.
privacy.noRequestsHint: Requests from the rights portal and those you log by hand appear here.
privacy.erasureNote: Erasure is applied by the retention engine after legal-hold checks; records kept by law are anonymised instead.
ret.sub: Keep periods per record type, legal holds and the dry-run report. Nothing is deleted in 2.0.
ret.noDeleteNote: The retention job only reports what would be erased or anonymised; deletion is enabled in a later release after review.
ret.holdsKicker: Held records are never erased or anonymised
ret.noHoldsHint: Place a hold on a record, a site or a record type during an investigation or claim.
ret.holdBody: Records under hold are excluded from retention until released. The reason is kept in the audit log.
ret.recordIdHint: Leave empty to hold every record of the type.
settings.sub: Company identity and the defaults every site inherits.
settings.legalNameHint: As on the privacy notice and statutory forms.
settings.mfaRolesHint: Admin, HSE manager, site head and site safety officer by default.
settings.defaultLangInList: The default language must be one of the offered languages.
settings.triageEscalate: Escalate triage to site head after (working days)
settings.dateChangeBeforeHead: Date-change requests before the site head decides
settings.dailyPushCapHint: Reminder pushes per person per day.
settings.photoQualityHint: 0.3–1.0; 0.8 keeps a 1,600 px photo around 300 KB.
settings.photoQualityRange: Photo quality must be between 0.3 and 1.0.
health.storageDbNote: Files are stored in the database; move to disk or object storage before the pilot grows.
health.staleJobs: {n} jobs have not run in 6 h
